'''Chak hearts''' were bits of [[Chak (substance)|bark]] from the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Spirit Tree]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Description==
[[Chak (substance)|Chak]] [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] were little more than a bits of bark from the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Spirit Tree]] with hearts drawn on them. They were symbols of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]]. During the Festival of Love festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] performed various deeds, such as participating in [[L-O53|matchmaking]] between couples, bundling love cards for Ewok children, and helping a [[Benjamin|disillusioned love sage]] re-discover the true meaning love. By completing these tasks, spacers were awarded Chak hearts which could be turned in for a variety of gifts.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Chak (substance)|Chak]] [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] were tokens awarded to players who performed various deeds during the [[Festival of Love]] celebrations. They were introduced to the [[Star Wars video games|game]] during the [[:w:c:swg:Ewok Festival of Love|Festival of Love]] of [[2009]]. They could be used to purchase a number of [[:w:c:swg:Item|items]], including [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] fountains, [[Ewok Festival of Love Crossbow|love crossbows]], [[:w:c:swg:Poster|paintings]], and more. Chark hearts were once again used during subsequent Festival of Love celebrations in [[2010]] and [[2011]].
